content_html:
Seasons in Cusco

Dry Season (April – October)

Stable weather
Sunny days
Ideal for tours and trekking

BEST time to visit Cusco

Top months:

  • May
  • June
  • July
  • August

Rainy Season (November – March)

Fewer tourists
Greener landscapes
Lower prices

Frequent rain
Possible delays

Still possible to travel, but requires planning

Which One Should You Choose?

Best photos → Dry season
Best prices → Rainy season
Trekking → Dry season

Important Tip

If you’re planning to visit Machu Picchu:

Avoid January and February if you want stable weather
Book in advance during high season

Recommendation

To make the most of your trip to Cusco:

Combine the right season + a good itinerary + an organized tour

Check available tours:
